title: One Company Out-Launches Every Country
source: Orbital launch attempts per year, compiled from SpaceNews, Payload and Aviation Week launch tallies plus the annual 'in spaceflight' launch logs. SpaceX (Falcon 9 + Falcon Heavy + Starship): 2019 13; 2020 26; 2021 31; 2022 61; 2023 98; 2024 134; 2025 ~170 (165 Falcon missions plus Starship test flights). China (all state and commercial providers): 2019 34; 2020 39; 2021 55; 2022 64; 2023 67; 2024 68; 2025 92. Russia (Roscosmos, all vehicles): 2019 25; 2020 17; 2021 25; 2022 21; 2023 19; 2024 17; 2025 17. Global orbital launch attempts hit a record ~324 in 2025, with the US and China together accounting for about 88% of them; SpaceX alone flew more missions than the rest of the world combined. Counts vary by a launch or two between trackers depending on how partial failures and suborbital test flights are classified.
